// Generator for gallery-alignment-layouts.json (FF-51): the gallery document of
// every layout that audit A flagged "export shape placement ignores layout that
// changes preview" (support-status.json at core 60e73d4: 50 partial, 7
// gallery-only). Each document is exactly what pptx-gallery's
// lib/opf-snippets.ts buildOpfSnippet('layouts', id) emits at the recorded
// gallery commit. Run from a pptx-gallery checkout that has its dependencies
// installed, with a core loader so the gallery bundle resolves
// @openpresentation/opf (for example opf/scripts/register-local-opf.mjs):
//   GALLERY_DIR=<pptx-gallery> IDS=ids.json node --import <opf>/scripts/register-local-opf.mjs gallery-alignment-layouts.mjs.txt test/fixtures/gallery-alignment-layouts.json
// where ids.json is [{"id": "...", "status": "partial" | "gallery-only"}, ...]
// taken from support-status.json (dimension layouts, that reason).
import {createRequire} from 'node:module';
import {mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import {execSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
const gallery = process.env.GALLERY_DIR;
const out = process.argv[2];
const ids = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.IDS, 'utf8'));
const {build} = createRequire(path.join(gallery, 'package.json'))('esbuild');
const scratch = mkdtempSync(path.join(gallery, 'node_modules', '.gallery-alignment-'));
const bundle = path.join(scratch, 'snippets.mjs');
await build({entryPoints: [path.join(gallery, 'lib/opf-snippets.ts')], outfile: bundle, bundle: true, platform: 'node', format: 'esm', packages: 'external', tsconfig: path.join(gallery, 'tsconfig.json'), logLevel: 'error'});
const snippets = await import(pathToFileURL(bundle));
rmSync(scratch, {recursive: true, force: true});
const commit = execSync('git rev-parse HEAD', {cwd: gallery}).toString().trim();
const layouts = ids.map(({id, status}) => ({id, status, document: JSON.parse(snippets.buildOpfSnippet('layouts', id))}));
writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify({
  $comment: 'FF-51 fixture. One gallery document per layout that audit A (support-status.json at core 60e73d4) flagged "export shape placement ignores layout that changes preview". Each document is exactly what pptx-gallery lib/opf-snippets.ts buildOpfSnippet("layouts", id) emits at the recorded gallery commit; regenerate with gallery-alignment-layouts.mjs.txt.',
  gallery: commit, layouts,
}, null, 1) + '\n');
console.log(`wrote ${layouts.length} layouts from pptx-gallery ${commit.slice(0, 7)} to ${out}`);
